unlisted_practices: Sampling informative cases for expert clinician review of risk prediction models to identify sources of information and improve model development
Deriving objective evaluation metrics from expert subjective evaluations of the problem formulation
Iterative expert-in-the-loop model improvement via thick data analytics

screen.reason: The paper presents and tests an empirical framework (Thick Data Analytics) that integrates domain expert feedback and qualitative case review to evaluate and refine risk prediction models (tested on an ICU transfer prediction model) prior to safe deployment.

primary.practice: thick data analytics framework for expert-human model evaluation
